Feature Film

Fighting Charity

In Development

After a young girl is abandoned by her family, she returns 20 years later to confront them, but in turn ignites a blood-feud.

Synopsis

Charity Sheridan is a scrappy nine-year old girl from a family of Irish travellers who dreams of becoming a professional boxer. In her eyes, life is perfect, she worships her bare-knuckle champion dad, her tight-knit family, and her roam-free life. When she accidentally kills a boy from a rival family, a vicious inter-family feud is ignited, and her own family has no option but to send her away until tensions subside. When her family never returns, she grows up in foster care, emotionally broken and angry at a world that discarded her.
